sessions.text:
User: I'm planning where to host a few small AWS workloads.
Assistant: Okay. Do you have a default region?
User: I prefer us-east-1 for deployments. Also, always add an owner tag with the value data-team to every cloud resource you define.
Assistant: Understood. I'll default to us-east-1 and tag every resource with owner=data-team.
User: Thanks, that's all for now.

User: I'm onboarding Project Gannet, a document archive for our European clients.
Assistant: Great. Any hosting constraints?
User: For Project Gannet, deploy to eu-west-1 because of data residency rules.
Assistant: Understood. For Project Gannet I'll deploy to eu-west-1.
User: Thanks. Talk soon.

User: Update on Project Gannet hosting.
Assistant: Go ahead.
User: Actually, for Project Gannet, switch to ap-southeast-1 because our new client base is in Singapore.
Assistant: Noted. Project Gannet will deploy to ap-southeast-1 from now on.
User: Perfect. That's it.
